verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance automation SaaS; no evidence of an official MCP server exposing it to AI agents—only integrations (Jira, JumpCloud, ClickUp, webhooks, REST APIs) and a separate GitHub 'compliance-skills' repo for code-scanning skills, none of which is an MCP server. Since Sprinto is a SaaS platform (not itself an agent), an official MCP server is a plausible axis, so absence of evidence yields 'none'.
